geisa-application-manifest.$comment: Example vendor application manifest. Defines vendor-supplied application identity, compatibility, defaults, requested permissions, and requested resource values before operator review, possible adjustment, and deployment approval.

manifest.$comment: Core application metadata and vendor-recommended settings.
manifest.author: GEISA Developer
manifest.name: Awesome App
manifest.description: This app makes your device awesome

artifacts.$comment: Single application artifact example. Additional artifact types may be added in future GEISA revisions.

api-access.$comment: Requested GEISA API access. Final granted access remains subject to platform and operator policy.

compatibility.$comment: Application requires GEISA API and LEE version 0.9.0, does not require VEE support, and identifies a vendor-defined toolchain target.

default-configuration.$comment: Vendor default configuration values. Operators may override these in the deployment manifest.

default-launch-strategy.$comment: Vendor-recommended launch and restart behavior. Final enforcement may be subject to platform and operator policy. The watchdog setting indicates whether the application supports the GEISA application watchdog mechanism.

communication.$comment: Requested communication access and limits. This example requests messaging access, HAN access, and local outbound network usage with a daily volume limit.

local.$comment: Vendor-requested local network usage. Outbound TCP port 80 is permitted in this example.

resources.$comment: Vendor-requested resource allocation limits for operator review.
